history.note: Removed InherentImpls::modules_by_self_ty and TraitImpls::modules_by_trait from reads.rs RULES. The delta queries and slice inputs are read only inside TraitImpls::for_crate_and_trait, InherentImpls::in_crate_for_self_ty, in_crate_trait_value_items and the whole-crate tables, never directly by a step, so they get no rule. for_crate_and_trait, two arguments, is listed as refused until 00827.
